name: Point Cloud Registration
description: Align point clouds into a common coordinate frame using RANSAC-based global registration and ICP local refinement.

videos.title: Point Cloud Rigid Registration: RANSAC & ICP

theory.overview:
Point cloud registration finds the optimal rigid transformation $T = (\mathbf{R}, \mathbf{t})$ that aligns a source point cloud $P$ to a target $Q$:

$$T^* = \arg\min_{\mathbf{R}, \mathbf{t}} \sum_{i=1}^{N} \|\mathbf{R} p_i + \mathbf{t} - q_{c(i)}\|^2$$

Global registration methods like RANSAC + FPFH features provide initial alignment before ICP refinement.

ransac_global.title: RANSAC Global Registration
ransac_global.content: RANSAC-based registration uses FPFH feature matching to establish correspondences, then estimates the best transformation from random subsets.

icp_refinement.title: ICP Refinement
icp_refinement.content: Iterative Closest Point alternates between finding correspondences via nearest-neighbor search and solving for $(\mathbf{R}, \mathbf{t})$ using SVD.

ransac_icp_pipeline.title: RANSAC + ICP Full Pipeline
ransac_icp_pipeline.content: Complete pipeline: apply a known transformation, then recover it using RANSAC global alignment followed by ICP local refinement.
